sites.note: confidence=medium. Article states the Maiden facility continues to get all of its electricity from Duke Energy. Catawba County is Duke Energy Carolinas territory; that BA split (DUK vs CPLE) is inferred from service territory, not stated.

confidence=medium. Article describes a joint Apple / NV Energy filing at the PUCN for a solar plant adjacent to Apple's Sparks data center connecting to a substation developed in partnership with Apple. NV Energy operates the single NEVP balancing authority statewide.

confidence=low. Apple's own release confirms the Waukee IA site but names no utility. MidAmerican Energy is the incumbent for Waukee and is reported to have built the campus substation; that link is inferred. Iowa is held at bare MISO.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
